what: Found why Dream moved the real arms blind: every camera frame it received in the 17:15 and 17:17 runs was the same frozen picture. The Dream loop now refuses frames unless the dashboard reports all three arm cameras live.
why: The arm cameras dropped (around the 17:10 power/USB loss) and the Mac dashboard kept serving each camera's last frame; cycle 1, 10 and 13 frames were byte-identical while the arm swung about 40 deg.
details: fetch_frames checks /state arm_cams before every Dream call and stops the run if any role is not live.
Restarting the Mac dashboard brought all three cameras back (verified live, scene changing).
On macOS a camera read can hang when the device vanishes, so the dashboard's own 2 s reconnect never ran; restart it after any USB or power loss.
